hostBoundaries.repoOwned: Checked-in plugin package assets plus root workspace mirrors and validators.
hostBoundaries.hostProductOnly: Copilot CLI plan/autopilot/delegation behavior is upstream host behavior and must cite GitHub documentation.
hostBoundaries.supportInfrastructure: Shell/Python/Node validation, bootstrap, smoke, and benchmark scripts are proof infrastructure, not the public product runtime.
outOfScope: OMC/OMX/Cursor parity claims as proof of repo behavior
